page_note: Dense substrate teaching: a sustained body→cosmos correspondence sequence mapping bodily parts/faculties to cosmic figures (Phergokatochos/Protomē, King of Honor/seventh heaven, Adamas of Light/Hyle, Stomach→King of Glory/wheels, Omophoros/Birah-Birē in soles, Virgin of Light, two ships of light). Ends with a new question-unit introducing 'four cosmoses / seven archons' teaching. The word ⲛⲉⲕⲗⲉⲕⲧⲟⲥ appears within the mapping but functions as the cosmic-anthropological recipient of the correspondence rather than an editorial church identification — both sides of every mapping stay within the cosmic system. Fatigue score is negative (-4.14): ecclesial vocab actually decreases in second half. Page is overwhelmingly substrate.
